name: What should I do if I smell sewer gas in my house?

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I smell sewer gas in my house?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you detect a sewer gas smell, first try to identify its source. Check seldom-used drains and pour a cup of water down them to refill the P-trap. Ensure all toilet seals are intact. If the smell persists, open windows to ventilate the area and contact a professional plumber. A plumber can use specialized tools to pinpoint the exact cause, whether it's a dry trap, a plumbing vent issue, a cracked pipe, or a more serious sewer line problem, and provide a lasting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ventilate your home, pour water down unused drains, and if the smell persists, contact a plumber to diagnose and fix the issue.
